heading: Friday, September 25, 2026
topLine: Claude computes a nine-loop scattering amplitude no one had calculated before.

items.headline: Claude computes a nine-loop scattering amplitude no one had calculated before
items.summary: Anthropic physicists Liam Fitzpatrick and Siddharth Mishra-Sharma had Claude compute the nine-loop six-particle MHV amplitude in planar N=4 super-Yang-Mills, answering a public challenge from physicist Matt von Hippel, largely unsupervised over several days for roughly $1,000-2,000 of compute. Lance Dixon, who published the eight-loop result in 2023, validated the output and the programs reproduced his published eight-loop symbol; it is a company blog post with released data files rather than a peer-reviewed paper, run once, and a separate group reached nine loops the same week using GPT-6 for some constraints.
